sentences.text:
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
June 11, 2024 48 Ardr Crr 2149 of 2024 Ishan Mohammad & anr.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & anr.
Adv. Rituparna De Ghosh, Adv. Siddhartha Paul, Adv. Souradeep Ghosh, ... for the petitioners.

The petitioners seek quashing of proceeding being CGR case no. 803 of 2024 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, South 24 Parganas under Sections 406/420/506/120B of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that there was a commercial transaction between the parties and the allegations leveled against the petitioners are false and frivolous.
The petitioners have submitted a supplementary affidavit which discloses issuance of notice under Section 41A of the Code upon the petitioners.
The petitioners intend to cooperate with the investigation and comply with the notice.
The supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioners is taken on record.
Upon consideration of the submission made on behalf of the petitioners, this Court is inclined to hold that the petitioners have been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the application upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 30 th August, 2024.

In the event the petitioners cooperate in investigation of the case and meet the Investigating Officer in reply to the notice issued upon them under Section 41A of the Code, no coercive action be taken against the petitioners in connection with the present proceeding till 31st August, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties upon compliance of all necessary formalities.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
